title: Agro Planner Update (v1.0.2)
releaseNotes:
- Background & Closed-App Notifications: Reliable native push & offline catch-up notifications with high-priority Android channels.
- Remote Version Control & Force Update Gate: Automatic startup version verification and release notes display.
- Real-Time Cloud Ledger Sync: Instant cross-device synchronization for syndicate members, livestock, and audit alerts.
- Version Transparency: Active app version and live update checker integrated in Settings.
